about.title: Engineering with discipline, building end-to-end.
paragraphs: I am an undergraduate software engineering student at the University of Dhaka (Institute of Information Technology) with a strong foundation in computer science and systems design. My focus lies primarily in the backend—architecting modular APIs, designing normalized database schemas, and building resilient background workflow systems.

Beyond pure backend logic, I enjoy operating as an end-to-end builder. I regularly build complete full-stack applications from scratch—handling everything from database design and containerization with Docker to crafting responsive frontends in Next.js. My recent projects, ApexFlow and InboxOrchestrator AI, reflect this approach: solving real architectural challenges like durable multi-step execution and high-efficiency background email processing.

During my internship at Tekarsh Bangladesh Ltd, I worked on automation testing, API performance validation, and web feature delivery. I believe in writing readable, maintainable code guided by SOLID principles rather than hasty patches that create technical debt.
